description.blurb: Belinda was discovered on Jan. 13, 1986 in images taken by Voyager 2. It is one of the 10 Uranian satellites discovered by the Voyager science team.
description.more: Little is known about Belinda other than its size and orbital characteristics. Based on its low albedo, its surface probably consists of the dark, unprocessed, carbon-rich material found on the C-class of asteroids.
